# awscc_msk_channel (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::MSK::Channel



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_name` (String) Name of the channel
- `topic_configuration_list` (Attributes List) Topic configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--topic_configuration_list))

### Optional

- `cluster_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cluster
- `encryption_configuration` (Attributes) Encryption configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--encryption_configuration))
- `iceberg_destination_configuration` (Attributes) Iceberg destination configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--iceberg_destination_configuration))
- `logging_info` (Attributes) Log configuration details for Channel (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logging_info))
- `s3_destination_configuration` (Attributes) S3 destination configuration (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--s3_destination_configuration))
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags attached to the channel

### Read-Only

- `channel_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the channel
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `state_info` (Attributes) Includes information about the channel state (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--state_info))
- `status` (String) Status of a channel resource

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_msk_channel.example
  identity = {
    channel_arn = "channel_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `channel_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) that uniquely identifies the channel

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_msk_channel.example
  id = "channel_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_msk_channel.example "channel_arn"
```
